The '''Raptor Clan''' was an organization on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nallastia]]. A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] named [[Alto]] was its [[Prince/Legends|prince]]. He was [[Marriage/Legends|betrothed]] to Princess [[Calvaria]], the daughter of Nallastia's [[Skull Queen]], and he lived a secret double life as a [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] named Rench.
